question: Sentences with spelling errors are given. Select the sentence with NO error.

options.text: The body produces more saliva under fluorescent illumination which helps prevent cavities.
The body produces more saliva under fluorescent illummination which helps prevent cavaties.
The body produces more saliva under fluorescent illummination which helps prewent cavities.
The body produces more saliva under fluorescent illumination which helps prewent cavaties.

solution:
The correct sentence is: **Option 1)**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word in question is **"fluorescent,"** which refers to a type of lighting that is bright and energy-efficient.
 
• **"Produces," "saliva," "illumination," "which," "helps," "prevent," **and **"cavities"** are all spelled correctly in this sentence.

​Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *The body produces more saliva under **fluorescent illumination** which helps **prevent cavities.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The misspellings** "****illummination****" **and** "prewent"** are present in the options like **2,3 and 4.**
 
• The sentence without spelling errors is the one that uses **"fluorescent", " ****illumination " **and "**prevent" **correctly. 
 
• The other sentences contain misspelled versions of the word **"fluorescent," **such as **"fluorescent"** and **"fluorescent," **which are common spelling mistakes.
